description: DAO treasury report, yearly: buy it in one x402 payment, $990 (USDC or USDT). Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /buy/dao-report-yearly, $990 in one payment), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. A free check first: POST the same body to /buy/dao-report-yearly/check (email required). Yearly plan; for one month use buy_dao_report. Payable with x402 or MPP.

address.description: optional treasury address if you have no Snapshot space

email.description: optional: where to send the files too; without it they are on the order status page

space.description: your Snapshot space id, e.g. yourdao.eth
